_comment: The 6-sprite picker grid: drives the REAL character-creation UI path. starts_at_title gives raw title control; creation_ui:true makes New Game open the creation screen (the default TestDriver skip goes straight to Game.reset with defaults, so every OTHER canonical is byte-unchanged). PC_OPTIONS is laid out row-major (row0 = Male across Human/Drake/Gnoll, row1 = Female) so cursor 0 starts on Human/Male; one move_right then one move_down lands on Drake/Female (same pick this canonical made pre-#42). Confirming the card sets pc_race+pc_gender TOGETHER (the payload keys the sim asserts below are byte-identical to before -- presentation-only recomposition). Asserts the snapshot identity fields, the sim variant sprite key, the GDI opener event (de-race-ified 2026-07-07 -- one opener for all races; `race` stays in the payload harmlessly, cosmetic only now), and the RENDERED variant binding on both the field (ui_entities_rendered pc_sprite) and combat is proven by the sim key (combat chip resolves the same pc_drake_f via board_renderer).
